cohort: 57 pregnant individuals with a diagnosis of vulvodynia and 41 pregnant control participants who reported being free of vulvar pain
finding: Pregnant women with vulvodynia experienced postpartum improvements in vulvar pain symptoms, and mode of birth may play a role in symptom trajectory.
mod_finding: Women with vulvodynia who delivered vaginally experienced reduced pain intensity postpartum, while only those who delivered via cesarean section reported increases in pain anxiety.
